{{Infobox auto}}

'''Glow berry crumble''' is the meal of [[Glow Berries|glow berries]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 1 minute, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/glow_berry_crumble.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Glow Berry Mash|Glow berry mash]], sugar, a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]] and dough. Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks the recipe. The milk bottle's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|8}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/soul_sight_apply_glow_60.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
